gitCommit.subject: WIP: feat(canvas): add 2K/4K resolution support for banana model (#1397)
gitCommit.body:
WIP: feat(canvas): add 2K/4K resolution support for banana model (#1397)

* feat(canvas): add 2K/4K resolution support for banana model

Add resolution selector dropdown to canvas floating textarea when using
Gemini/banana models. Resolution flows through the full stack:
UI → hook → client → API → Gemini SDK (imageConfig.imageSize).

Pricing is DB-configurable via new tokenCost2k/tokenCost4k fields on
BaseModel, with fallback to default tokenCost when not set.

* fix(canvas): use useMemo for resolution cost and add DB migration

Replace getResolutionCost arrow function with useMemo to prevent
unnecessary handleSubmit re-creation on every render. Add Prisma
migration for tokenCost2k/tokenCost4k fields on BaseModel.

* fix(canvas): fix resolution selector overflow and improve UX

- Fix Combobox text overflow by adding truncate wrapper (matching MultiCombobox)
- Replace dropdown with inline button group for resolution selection
- Default resolution to 1K instead of empty placeholder
- Shorten resolution placeholder text across all locales
- Restrict resolution selector to Nano Banana Pro model only
- Disable search in resolution selector combobox

* fix(stories): add missing tokenCost2k/tokenCost4k to BaseModel mock data

The 2K/4K resolution feature added these fields to the Prisma schema,
but Storybook stories were not updated, causing build failures in CI.
